exposure.needed: whether external-secrets CRDs in this environment are installed separately from the chart (e.g. applied via kubectl apply of deploy/crds/bundle.yaml) rather than managed by the Helm chart

consequence.statement: Operators upgrading an environment whose CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error occurs, then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.

assertion.statement: Environments upgrading to external-secrets 0.16 where the CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
